criteria.description: The shared next/implement hook opts into the canonical missing-charter advisory and emits its warning instead of aborting.
criteria.evidence: Real next/implement hook tests reproduce the absent-charter state. Command-wrapper tests test_next_json_advancing_preserves_advisory_on_stderr and test_next_query_preserves_advisory_on_stderr cover advancing/query and human/JSON routing while asserting clean stdout. Baseline live hook exited 1; fixed paths continue.
criteria.notes: Initial red-first consumer tests: 4bc73dbc6 then 4493699b0. Wrapper/cold-import red tests: 3f5ab1082 then implementation 3dc72aa04.

criteria.description: A canonically safe missing stack with legacy charter.md prose remains advisory, while charter.md never changes the pass/block decision.
criteria.evidence: tests/specify_cli/charter_preflight/test_runner.py covers missing and built_in_only DRG variants with and without charter.md, plus test_charter_md_never_exempts_stale_or_invalid_residue for stale/invalid canonical states.
criteria.notes: Canonical _is_optional_missing_charter_stack executes before the display-only _is_legacy_charter_bundle wording selector.

criteria.description: Legacy advisories are distinct, visible at every live consumer, and name an executable no-interview migration command.
criteria.evidence: test_legacy_warning_remediation_command_generates_charter_yaml executes `charter generate --no-from-interview`; next wrapper tests cover all four advancing/query + human/JSON modes with stderr/clean-stdout assertions; implement asserts stderr; dashboard command asserts persistence/rendering.
criteria.notes: Warning metadata alone was rejected as fakeable by the first adversarial squad; command-boundary delivery is now tested.

criteria.description: Stale, invalid, and other partial canonical charter states continue to fail closed regardless of charter.md presence.
criteria.evidence: test_charter_md_never_exempts_stale_or_invalid_residue parameterizes synced stale, DRG stale, and DRG invalid with charter.md present; existing invalid next/implement tests retain exit-1 and no-worktree-allocation assertions.
criteria.notes: Direct adversarial probe [missing, missing, stale] + charter.md now returns passed=False instead of rewriting checks to skipped.

criteria.description: One shared hook owns mutation-consumer opt-in and warning emission; one runner predicate owns canonical advisory qualification.
criteria.evidence: src/specify_cli/charter_runtime/preflight/hook.py::run_preflight_or_abort is shared by next and implement; src/specify_cli/charter_runtime/preflight/runner.py::_is_optional_missing_charter_stack is the single advisory predicate; no consumer-local exemption logic exists.
criteria.notes: Dashboard uses the same runner contract and separately persists advisory presentation state.

criteria.description: Legacy copy selection performs one charter.md existence check without eagerly loading the heavyweight charter package on next startup.
criteria.evidence: test_legacy_bundle_detection_costs_at_most_one_additional_exists_call pins one Path.exists call; test_runner_cold_import_under_500ms runs a fresh-process import and rejects the former ~1.1s eager charter.bundle regression.
criteria.notes: CHARTER_MD remains canonical and is imported lazily only inside the post-qualification copy selector.

criteria.description: Pre-existing invalid, stale, partial, and passing charter-preflight coverage remains green.
criteria.evidence: 63/63 focused tests passed; full contract suite 297 passed/5 skipped; full architecture suite 1487 passed/2 skipped/2 xfailed; charter-path authority 4/4.
criteria.notes: Architecture emitted one pre-existing shrink-census warning only.

criteria.description: Canonical freshness states alone decide advisory qualification; charter.md can select warning copy only.
criteria.evidence: Built-in-only passes with and without prose; missing/missing/stale and stale/invalid variants with prose remain blocked; direct probes confirm identical pass/block outcomes across prose presence.

criteria.description: Qualification and consumer delivery each have one shared implementation point.
criteria.evidence: runner._is_optional_missing_charter_stack owns qualification; hook.emit_advisory_warnings owns formatting; run_preflight_or_abort is shared by next/implement; next wrapper only preserves routing; dashboard only persists presentation.

criteria.description: Regression tests cover canonical pass/block behavior and visible delivery at every consumer boundary.
criteria.evidence: Runner tests cover missing, built_in_only, stale and invalid with prose; actual next wrapper covers four modes; implement hook asserts stderr/no allocation; dashboard command asserts persistence; remediation command is executed.
criteria.notes: Two red/green commit pairs preserve failure-before-fix evidence.

negative_invariants.invariant: Adding or removing display-only charter.md cannot change passed or blocked_reason for identical canonical layer states.
Stale, invalid, or other partial canonical residue is never rewritten to skipped by the missing-charter advisory.
A passed advisory is not discarded by advancing/query human/JSON next, implement, or dashboard; JSON stdout remains machine-clean.
